articleTitle: What to Say When You Learn About a Death Months Later
imageHeadline: What to Say When You Learn About a Death Months Later
imageSubtext: The exact words that still mean something weeks or months after loss
pinTitle: what to say when you find out about a death months later how to offer support for delayed grief
pinDescription: You just found out your friend lost someone important months ago, and you're not sure what to say now that time has passed. This guide walks through how to acknowledge a late condolence, offer meaningful support after the immediate grief window, and what specific words still matter weeks or months later. See the full script and examples.
